title: Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Health, Safety and Environment (HSE). Category: Vocational Training Courses. Duration: 3 months. Description: Covers fire prevention, accident prevention during construction, chemical safety and hazards, machine safety, emergency preparedness and response, and fire fighting equipment. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
